title: FeaturePlanService
responsibility: Orchestrate revisioned feature plans and require verification before approval.

inputs.name: constructor.dependencies
inputs.type: {repository: Pick<FeaturePlanRepository,"read"|"append"|"approve">, validator: Pick<FeaturePlanValidator,"validate">, verifyReady?: (plan: FeaturePlan) => Promise<void>, now?: () => string}
inputs.description: Explicit trusted collaborators. verifyReady checks committed source and all selected design artifacts; it must be present and failures fail closed.

inputs.name: draft.input
inputs.description: A full proposed plan without revision, digest or approval; the service computes the next revision and a canonical SHA-256 digest.

inputs.name: select.input
inputs.description: Select a page option only against the latest unmodified draft digest, creating a new unapproved revision.

inputs.name: approve.input
inputs.description: Approve only latest valid fully selected plan after trusted readiness verification.

inputs.name: approved.input
inputs.description: Select the latest exact approved plan for dispatch revalidation.

outputs.name: draft
outputs.description: Schema- and graph-valid immutable unapproved revision committed to the plan repository.

outputs.name: select
outputs.description: A new revision with the selected option and a fresh digest.

outputs.name: approve
outputs.description: Approval bound to the exact latest validated digest after successful readiness verification.

outputs.name: approved
outputs.description: Checks the latest canonical digest and approval, validates full selection, reruns trusted readiness, then rereads the latest plan and rejects any content or approval race; returns a defensive copy.

errors.name: invalid or stale plan
errors.description: Reject malformed or inconsistent plans, tampered digests, stale expected digest, unknown page or option, missing selection, readiness failure, and concurrent repository conflicts without approval or further mutation.

errors.name: approval invalid or stale
errors.description: Rejects missing, unapproved, tampered, stale, unready or concurrently changed plans without mutation.
